name: West Berlin
alt: American, British and French sectors of Berlin

predecessors.name: Allied-occupied Germany
predecessors.text: the American, British and French sectors of Berlin, divided from the Soviet sector in 1945

successors.name: Germany (reunified)
successors.text: Berlin, where 'East and West Berlin formally reunited and joined the Federal Republic as a city-state' on 3 October 1990

ledger.x: 1945: the Western Allies take their sectors of Berlin.
September 1948: West Berlin becomes a separate jurisdiction.
October 1958: the French sector passes from the Fourth to the Fifth Republic.
October 1958: the Fifth Republic holds the French sector from the new constitution (infobox: 'New constitution adopted: 4 October 1958') until 3 October 1990.
3 October 1990: the American sector's occupation ends.
3 October 1990: the British sector's occupation ends (same sentence).
3 October 1990: the French sector's occupation ends (same sentence).
3 October 1990: West Berlin and East Berlin are reunited and join the Federal Republic as a city-state.

wars.name: Berlin Blockade
wars.outcome: The Soviets blockaded the Western sectors from 24 June 1948 to 12 May 1949; the Western Allies supplied the city by the Berlin Airlift and kept it; no border moved.

certainty.note: The sector boundary through the city was fixed by the occupation agreements and later walled (13 August 1961); the page gives no coordinates.
